test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is an example of revenue expenditure in a government budget?

options.text: Payment of salary of government employees

solution:
The correct answer is __**Payment of salary of government employees**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Payment of salary of government employees** is classified as a **revenue expenditure **in a government budget.
 
• Revenue expenditure refers to the **expenses that are incurred for the normal functioning of government** departments and various services, interest payments on debt, subsidies, etc.
 
• Such expenditures do not result in the creation of assets or reduction in liabilities.
 
• Examples include **salaries, pensions, interest payments, and administrative expenses**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Capital expenditure**, on the other hand, includes **expenses incurred on the acquisition of assets** like land, buildings, machinery, etc., and investments in shares.
 
• It also includes loans granted by the government to states, union territories, and other parties.
 
• Examples of capital expenditure are construction of new highways, investment in state-owned companies, and repayment of loans.
